actions: We implemented the ContextDB system based on arXiv paper 2603
The team decided to use a 3-level hierarchy for context management: task, session, and project levels
We added MemoryDistiller class that extracts entities, actions, decisions, and facts from conversations
The system achieves significant token reduction by storing only distilled information instead of full conversations

actions: Today we optimized the 7-Persona system with three major improvements
First, we adjusted the Coordinator role to remove mandatory rest suggestions per user preference
Second, we established confidence thresholds for Innovator auto-execution: >=90% auto, 70-89% quick confirm, <70% full review
Third, we implemented Meta-Cognition real-time monitoring every 30 minutes with automatic alerts

actions: Stock Analyzer Phase 3 implementation completed with financial fraud detection and risk monitoring
py implements three classic models: Beneish M-Score (8 variables), Altman Z-Score (5 variables), Piotroski F-Score (9 variables)
py tracks four risk dimensions: volatility (30% weight), correlation (25%), liquidity (20%), valuation (25%)
